newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-AVERAGE GROSS WAGES UP 18.4 PERCENT IN Q1 1997.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-AVERAGE GROSS WAGES UP 18.4 PERCENT IN Q1 1997.

text.p: Average gross wages for both full-time and part-time employees in the first quarter of 1997 increased by 18.4 percent from the first quarter of 1996, the statistics office said on Wednesday.
Average gross wages in the first quarter of 1997 were 3,136 kroons compared to 2,649 kroons in the same period of 1996, the the statistics office said in its monthly publication.
The highest average wages were paid in the financial sector with 7,065 kroons, while the lowest was in the agricultural sector with 1,714 kroons.
The highest wages were paid in Harju county, including Tallinn, with 3,818 kroons, and the lowest was paid in the central Estonia county of Jogeva with 2,168 kroons.
